items.title: Narrow breadth cushioned by positive dealer gamma into the pre-market open
items.note: Market breadth sits well below its broad-market threshold (heatmap 49.85% positive vs 60%, margin -10.15, narrow leadership) at the same time SPY dealer gamma is positive (signedNetGEX +$7.73B, spot 774 above the 770.98 flip, call wall 775 / put wall 770) and the last completed intraday tape is a two-sided Reversal risk auction (VWAP 772.74). Fewer than half of constituents are participating while a pinning, move-dampening dealer structure holds, yet the bench still reads bull-stacked (swing 20>50>200) and volatility is calm. Structurally this is a pin-cage over fragile internals — narrow leadership whose downside is temporarily muffled by positive gamma rather than a broad, healthy advance. It is an emergent cross-tool divergence, not any single owner read; the cushion lapses and the read flips to break-watch if spot loses the 770.98 flip.
items.method: Cross-tool divergence flag: compare market-heatmap-lab breadthPct against its own 60% broad threshold (sign of the margin), then overlay the options-structure and gamma-trading dealer-gamma sign together with spot-versus-flip position and the intraday-tape session type. Raise the pattern only when breadth is below threshold AND dealer gamma is positive AND spot sits above the flip (pinning), all against a calm-volatility, bull-stacked bench — flagging a suppressed-volatility cushion over narrow internals, and inverting to break-watch once spot falls below the flip.
inputs: market-heatmap-lab: breadthPct 49.85, threshold 60, margin -10.15, 134 constituents, leadership narrow
options-structure-lab: signedNetGEX 7728904082.2469, flipLevel 770.98, spot 774, callWall 775, putWall 770, expectedMove 5.21
gamma-trading-lab: regime positive, scenario pin-to-maxpain, flip 770.98, callWall 775, putWall 770
intraday-tape-lab: sessionType Reversal risk, control Algo-controlled, vwap 772.74, gapPct 0.55
